messages:
omar: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands segment on customer wins/losses. Short summary: wins = repeatable migration runbooks, transparent token costing, predictable latency in demos. Losses = delays on security integrations (KMS/HSM), unclear p99 guarantees, and rare model regressions on domain-specific prompts. Asking leadership and owners to confirm next steps.
rachel: Thanks Omar — useful summary. From GTM: the highest ROI fixes are KMS onboarding docs + a simple SLA menu AEs can share in mid-stage demos.
kai: Eng note: model regressions are mostly reproducible with a small eval set. Proposed short-term mitigations: (1) fallback stable model family for sensitive workloads, (2) prefix/KV eviction visibility in metrics. Both doable in a 2-6 week small-squad sprint.
anya: Product: customers ask for a one-page migration playbook (prereqs, test traffic, rollback) and a two-line "what to expect" card for AEs. Can CS/AE share redacted closed-lost notes?
selina: CS: I can redact 3 lost deals and add the "what was missing" + "what would have changed their mind" bullets. Also will draft the migration checklist template (prereqs, tests, go/no-go).
omar: Leadership Qs: who will own (A) SLA menu & legal loop, (B) migration one-pager + AE card, (C) fallback model canary + KV telemetry? Please @ owners so we can track.
rachel: I will take (A) and pull legal/security in.
kai: I'll own (C) and propose a canary checklist. Need product to drop the eval prompts for the regression cases by Thurs.
anya: I'll lead (B) with Selina/CS. Comms can help word the AE card.
selina: Confirming I'll post the redacted lost-deal notes by EOD Wednesday and a draft checklist by Friday.
followup-bot: Created ticket RW-3344: "All-hands follow-up - SLA menu, migration playbook, fallback canary" assigned to rachel,kai,anya.
omar: Action summary: rachel (SLA + legal), anya/selina (one-pager + lost-deals), kai (canary + telemetry), omar (compile evals + runbook). Proposed 30min sync Fri 11am. React with :thumbsup: if that works or suggest alternate times.
